# telnyx_messaging_profile_short_codes (Data Source)

Lists the short codes assigned to a messaging profile.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

- `messaging_profile_id` (String) The messaging profile id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
